objective: Complete a ten-step Task 113 GRPO parameter-update development run with the audited staged-v7 reward, inspect checkpoints 2, 5, and 10, then compare the updated adapters against the exact SFT checkpoint under one frozen sampling protocol.

phases.acceptance: Config, split, opening manifest, staged reward, optimization arithmetic, and focused tests pass without API or GPU.
phases.evidence: The ten-step configuration passed 116 focused tests with one unrelated upstream audioop deprecation warning; Ruff passed; git diff --check reported only existing Windows line-ending warnings.

phases.acceptance: Bound model/upstream hashes match; BF16 and CUDA are available; DeepSeek preflight passes; no training starts during preflight.

Exactly 10 optimizer steps and 40 transport-complete rollouts; at least one group has nonzero reward std; finite loss/gradients/KL; trainable parameter fingerprint changes; checkpoints 2, 5, and 10 and all raw artifacts are preserved.
SFT and GRPO are sampled with identical Task 113 opening, seed, n=4, decoding, budgets, user simulator, and evaluator; trajectory-level reward components and bad cases are audited.

stop_rules: Stop before optimization if any hash or dependency binding differs.
Fail closed before reward/backward if any rollout in a training group is truncated or transport-incomplete.
Stop interpretation if all groups have zero reward standard deviation.
Do not call reward increase a business improvement without frozen post-evaluation.
Do not continue beyond 10 steps automatically.
